YOUR TRACKER

Connect your flight tracker

Use your dashboard endpoint and its dedicated tokens. Your flight API and database secret keys never belong here.

The control token lets you switch or stop the pilot flight. Connection details stay only in this browser tab’s session. See UI-CONTROLS-SETUP.md for setup.

ONE FLIGHT AT A TIME

Track a flight

Choose a U.S. domestic flight departing in the next 24 hours.

Enter the published schedule. Saving uses no flight-data units; the hourly worker checks it later within the existing budget. This form does not search airline schedules.

FLIGHT MONITORING

Stop tracking this flight?

This stops future checks and clears this flight’s saved live status and changes. Your shared API usage counters remain in place. An already running request may still finish.
